review_candidates.title: Senior System Engineer / Sistemista Informatico Senior – Infrastrutture IT
review_candidates.description: Senior System Engineer / Sistemista Informatico Senior – Infrastrutture IT Sede: Brugnera (PN) Contratto: tempo indeterminato RAL: 38.000–42.000 € lordi annui, commisurata all’esperienza e all’effettiva autonomia tecnica   ADPC è un MSP/MSSP che affianca aziende nella gestione, sicurezza ed evoluzione delle proprie infrastrutture IT.   Per rafforzare il nostro staff tecnico cerchiamo un Senior System Engineer / Sistemista Informatico Senior con esperienza concreta nella gestione di infrastrutture Microsoft, virtualizzazione, networking e servizi cloud.   La persona entrerà a far parte di un team tecnico già operativo e lavorerà su infrastrutture di clienti differenti, occupandosi sia della gestione quotidiana e delle escalation tecniche sia di migrazioni e progetti evolutivi. Cerchiamo una figura tecnica e operativa, capace di prendere in carico ambienti esistenti, comprenderne rapidamente struttura e dipendenze, individuare le criticità e intervenire con autonomia e metodo.   Di cosa ti occuperai gestione e troubleshooting di Windows Server e Active Directory; gestione di infrastrutture VMware ESXi / vSphere e Hyper-V; amministrazione Microsoft 365, Exchange Online ed Entra ID; networking TCP/IP, VLAN, routing, switching e connettività; configurazione e troubleshooting di firewall, NAT e VPN; gestione di sistemi di backup, restore e disaster recovery; monitoraggio, patching e gestione proattiva delle infrastrutture tramite piattaforme RMM; gestione di escalation e problematiche sistemistiche di secondo e terzo livello; migrazioni, upgrade e progetti infrastrutturali; aggiornamento della documentazione tecnica degli ambienti gestiti; collaborazione con gli altri componenti dello staff tecnico; coordinamento diretto con clienti, software house, operatori e altri fornitori. L'attività viene svolta sia da remoto sia presso le sedi dei clienti.   Cosa cerchiamo Esperienza concreta e buona autonomia in buona parte dei seguenti ambiti: Windows Server e Active Directory; VMware e/o Hyper-V; Microsoft 365 ed Entra ID; networking e firewall; backup, restore e disaster recovery; troubleshooting infrastrutturale.   Per noi essere “senior” non significa solamente avere molti anni di esperienza. Cerchiamo soprattutto una persona capace di analizzare un'infrastruttura nel suo insieme, individuare servizi critici e dipendenze, approfondire la causa dei problemi e portare le attività a conclusione assumendosene la responsabilità tecnica. Costituisce un forte vantaggio aver maturato esperienza presso MSP, system integrator o società di consulenza IT , lavorando contemporaneamente su clienti e infrastrutture differenti.   Sono inoltre richieste: capacità di organizzare autonomamente attività e priorità; capacità di relazionarsi direttamente con clienti e fornitori; attitudine al lavoro in team e alla condivisione delle informazioni; buona comprensione dell'inglese tecnico; patente B e disponibilità a interventi presso i clienti locali.   Costituiscono un plus Esperienza con tecnologie e piattaforme quali: WatchGuard, Fortinet o soluzioni firewall equivalenti; Datto, Veeam o altre piattaforme di backup e disaster recovery; piattaforme RMM e PSA; Auvik o strumenti di monitoring infrastrutturale; Microsoft Azure e Intune; strumenti EDR e di endpoint security; PowerShell; ambienti Linux. La conoscenza dei singoli prodotti utilizzati da ADPC è comunque secondaria rispetto alla capacità di comprendere, gestire e risolvere problematiche infrastrutturali in autonomia.   Cosa offriamo inserimento in uno staff tecnico già operativo ; contratto a tempo indeterminato; RAL 38.000–42.000 € lordi annui , definita sulla base dell'esperienza e dell'autonomia tecnica; lavoro su infrastrutture, tecnologie e clienti differenti; partecipazione diretta a progetti infrastrutturali e di evoluzione tecnologica; formazione e aggiornamento tecnico; autonomia operativa e responsabilità crescenti; possibilità di crescita.   La ricerca è rivolta a candidate e candidati , nel rispetto della normativa vigente in materia di pari opportunità e non discriminazione.

review_candidates.title: Senior Information Technology System Administrator
review_candidates.description: Company Description QuadraTech for Information Technology S.A.E., founded in 1999, specializes in delivering state-of-the-art emerging technologies to the Egyptian market. The company supports corporate customers by developing and implementing integrated solutions that enhance and improve business performance. With strong capabilities in designing, deploying, and evolving IT solutions, QuadraTech serves diverse market segments with tailored offerings. The organization focuses on positioning technology as a strategic asset, helping clients gain efficiency, agility, and competitive advantage. Role Description We are looking for a Senior IT System Administrator to manage, maintain, and improve our Microsoft-based servers infrastructure and virtualized environments. You will be the technical lead for day-to-day system operations, support system integration projects, and make sure our systems are secure, available, and performing well. This is a hands-on infrastructure role, not a software development position. Key Responsibilities Install, configure, and maintain Windows Server environments, including Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and file and print services. Administer and monitor VMware virtual infrastructure (vSphere, ESXi, vCenter), including provisioning, capacity planning, and performance tuning. Manage and support Symantec security and backup solutions, including endpoint protection, policy configuration, updates, and incident response. Take part in system integration projects, including planning, deployment, testing, and handoff to operations. Perform patch management, system upgrades, and routine maintenance to keep systems secure and up to date. Monitor system health, troubleshoot complex issues, and resolve incidents within agreed service levels. Manage backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity procedures, and test them regularly. Maintain system documentation, configuration records, and standard operating procedures. Provide Level 2 and Level 3 support and mentor junior administrators and help desk staff. Work with network, security, and application teams, as well as vendors, to deliver reliable IT services. Required Qualifications 3 to 5 years of hands-on experience as a System Administrator or in a similar infrastructure role. Prior experience working in a System Integration environment. Strong knowledge of Microsoft server technologies (Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, Exchange/Microsoft 365 administration). Proven experience with VMware virtualization (vSphere, ESXi, vCenter). Prior experience with Symantec systems (e.g., Endpoint Protection, Backup Exec, or related products). Good understanding of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, firewalls). Experience with backup, recovery, and monitoring tools. MCSE (Microsoft Certified Solutions Expert) and MCSA (Microsoft Certified Solutions Associate), or equivalent current Microsoft certifications. Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. What We Offer Competitive salary and benefits package Professional development and certification support A collaborative team environment with room for career growth

This is a varied, customer-focused position involving technical support, infrastructure, system maintenance and hands-on work at client locations. The successful candidate will be comfortable working across multiple technologies and taking ownership of issues through to resolution. The Role Serve as a technical contact for customers and provide effective solutions to their IT requirements. Attend customer premises when required to diagnose faults, complete repairs and carry out scheduled maintenance. Manage support cases and service requests using the company's Service Desk platform. Keep customers informed throughout the support process in accordance with agreed service levels. Escalate significant incidents and issues requiring Management intervention. Monitor the condition and performance of customer environments and ensure business requirements continue to be met. Carry out the installation, configuration, testing, maintenance and repair of hardware and software. Keep technical records, tickets and documentation up to date. Take ownership of urgent and high-priority incidents, whether handled remotely or on-site. On Offer Salary of £30,000 - £40,000 per year, dependent on experience. 40 days' annual paid holiday. Microsoft 365 applications and cloud services, particularly Email, SharePoint, Teams and OneDrive (mandatory). Intune, Remote Monitoring and Management platforms and telephone systems. Network infrastructure including routers, switches, access points, DHCP, DNS, TCP/IP, firewalls and VLANs. External technology partners and service providers, with the ability to coordinate support where required. IT industry standards, processes and best-practice procedures. Windows Server 2016, 2019 and 2022, including Group Policy and security configuration. Azure administration and implementation. Windows 10, Windows 11 and Mac environments. Different customer builds, imaging and deployment requirements. Strong customer service skills together with clear written and verbal communication. Independent technical troubleshooting and problem-solving. Working effectively within a team while being capable of managing tasks independently.
